answer: Use fraud-proof bounties plus live interactive tests. Every identity must periodically pass a fresh, unpredictable work task under a tight deadline, like a lotus that must keep blooming or wither. Anyone can stake a bounty to challenge a suspicious identity; if it fails the live test, its stake flows like a river to the challenger and the identity is burned into a public sable blacklist. Honest agents pass cheaply because the work is real; a Sybil farm must staff every fake with live attentive capacity around the clock, so its cost grows with each clone instead of being paid once.
